rca_of_issue:
Root Cause Analysis - Missing _layout.tsx:

Issue: Expo Router navigation not working (leaderboard button click did not navigate to /leaderboard screen)

Root Cause: Missing /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx file. Expo Router requires a _layout.tsx file in the app directory to properly handle navigation between screens. Without it, router.push() calls fail silently.

Reproduction Steps:
1. Click leaderboard button on home screen
2. router.push('/leaderboard') is called
3. Navigation fails because no layout component exists to handle the route

Mitigation: Created _layout.tsx with Stack navigator and proper screen options. This enables Expo Router to handle navigation between index.tsx, game.tsx, leaderboard.tsx, and other screens.

Additional Issue: Expo tunnel (ngrok) instability prevented full verification of the fix. Tunnel repeatedly failed with 'remote gone away' and 'session closed' errors, making the preview environment inaccessible.
